# Quaver Desk

> Quaver Desk is a self-hosted business phone system (PBX) for small teams of 2 to 100 people, made in the UK. It is a web app with its own FreeSWITCH voice server, runs on one Linux server or VM (Debian 12 or Ubuntu 24.04), and works with any SIP trunk (Twilio, Gamma, BT, Simwood, Voiceflex and others). There are no per-minute platform fees: calls are billed by the SIP trunk provider. It is source-available under the Elastic License 2.0.

Key facts:

- Free plan: up to 3 users, 1 number, 1 SIP trunk, no licence key and no time limit.
- Paid plans are priced per site by team size, not per seat. No VAT is added.
  - Plus: £15/month (up to 5 users), £29 (6–10), £49 (11–25), £89 (26–50), £149 (51–100).
  - Pro: £29/month (up to 5 users), £55 (6–10), £99 (11–25), £179 (26–50), £299 (51–100).
  - Yearly billing: 12 months for the price of 10. Over 100 users: quote.
- Hosted option, on UK servers: Plus/Pro per month: £49/£69 (up to 5 people, 2 numbers, 1,000 UK call minutes a month), £89/£129 (6–10, 4 numbers, 2,500 minutes), £179/£259 (11–25, 8 numbers, 6,000 minutes), £329/£479 (26–50, 15 numbers, 12,000 minutes). Over 50: quote. Included minutes cover incoming calls and calls to UK landlines and mobiles; past them, and for international calls, calls are charged per minute (call-rates page). Calls on a customer's own SIP provider use no minutes and are not charged.
- Features on every plan: phone in the browser, opening hours, ring groups, IVR menus, follow-me to mobiles with call acceptance, transfer, hold, call park, voicemail to email, two-factor sign-in, toll-fraud limits, 999 calls never blocked.
- Plus adds: SIP desk phones with automatic set-up (Yealink, Grandstream, Fanvil; Yealink DECT bases), call recording with announcement, AI transcripts and summaries using the customer's own AI provider account, call queues with hold music and ring strategies, reports and CSV export, webhooks (Zapier, Make, n8n), a read-only API, passkeys.
- Pro adds: AI receptionist, AI search across calls, AI action items and sentiment, live wallboard, queue and per-person reports, supervisor listen/whisper/join, HubSpot CRM integration, click-to-call over the API, single sign-on with Microsoft Entra and Google Workspace, directory sync (SCIM 2.0).
- It is not tied to one carrier: it works with any SIP trunk, including Gamma, Voiceflex, Twilio, BT and Simwood.
